title: Bringing powerful AI to millions across Europe with Deutsche Telekom
summary: OpenAI is collaborating with Deutsche Telekom to bring advanced, multilingual AI experiences to millions of people across Europe. ChatGPT Enterprise will also be deployed to help employees at Deutsche Telekom improve workflows and accelerate innovation.
body: OpenAI is collaborating with Deutsche Telekom to bring advanced, multilingual AI experiences to millions of people across Europe. ChatGPT Enterprise will also be deployed to help employees at Deutsche Telekom improve workflows and accelerate innovation.
summaryZh: OpenAI与德国电信（Deutsche Telekom）达成战略合作，旨在为欧洲数百万用户提供多语言AI体验。作为合作的核心，德国电信将在企业内部全面部署ChatGPT Enterprise，以优化员工工作流程并加速业务创新。该案例体现了大型电信运营商通过集成先进大模型来提升运营效率的趋势，为企业级AI应用提供了参考范式。
